metadata.title: Paid-launch cloud acceptance traceability matrix
metadata.customer_endpoint: A paid user obtains understandable grounded coaching, deliberately practises the same target, sees honest improvement evidence, and finds the experience valuable enough to choose to return. Referral is an aspiration, not a predicted or measured claim.
metadata.authorization: No dispatch,sourcechange,merge,deploy,migration,identity/credential/provider mutation ornewrecording authorized. Existingmetadata closureblocksunchanged.

Fulloriginalcontracts retained in source-manifest.json; historicalpolicy conflicts requirecurrent-authority reconciliation,notautomaticgateactivation. Notanexhaustive reread of2500+historicalRWTcomments. ExplicitPG17/privacy retirement-receiver bugchecklists also copied;retiredfinance/Orchsource histories preserved withoutnewimplementation.
metadata.test_id_caveat: TraceabilityIDs identify agent-run procedures or existing script aliases; a new committed test function is not required. All151active requirements link a concrete procedure+retained assertion. Missing feature observed under valid conditions=FAIL. Only missing access/authority/repro/oracle causesNOTRUN/HOLD. Source-onlyPASS never substitutes live/human.

PG01.name: Fast, accurate Private transcription
PG01.owner: Jensen — model/qualification; Elon retains shared App lifecycle ownership
PG01.customer_outcome: On the selected served engine/model and representative devices/corpus: no repeated/lost speech or Stop-tail corruption; truthful live/final/save text; measured near-zero WER and little/no perceptible mic-stop delay against explicitly agreed numerical launch bounds. Publish per-clip and tail-latency results; real spoken uh and mic permissions are separately observed. Original negative controls fail before the fix and pass after. Source/synthetic tests alone do not close this.

PG02.name: Useful coaching → same-target practice → visible improvement
PG02.owner: Elon — App product/source; Sam accepts the retained contract
PG02.customer_outcome: Open Mic, full Focus and partial Focus each complete: saved evidence supports the displayed 1+1 actionable advice; the same accepted target survives Session/Home/Progress/saved review/reopen; its linked repeat shows the correct before/after and an honest target-specific outcome, never unrelated latest-session or numeric-causality claims. Focus point/order and missing/expired evidence stay truthful; copy/PDF/privacy agree. Named humans judge grounding, relevance, usefulness and improvement. Keep soft~8–10words/no hard16-word rejection.

PG03.name: Safe account exit, isolation and retained-data privacy
PG03.owner: Jensen — account/runtime; Elon — customer entry/UI; Sam — exact operational acceptance
PG03.customer_outcome: Authenticated user can find the correct entry, cancel safely or complete scoped closure without harming other users. Pending billing/coaching/save obligations settle or truthfully HOLD; no engine-off/absent-lease/503 shortcut. Own-user positives and cross-user negatives pass. Newest-one retention, real-PG concurrent edits, permission/trigger guards and required Auth/storage/FK cleanup pass on the actual applied schema. Repeated requests/lost replies remain safe. Data intentionally retained is disclosed; no total-erasure claim.

PG04.name: Reliable Start, Stop, save and recovery
PG04.owner: Jensen — recovery/evidence; Elon — App lifecycle within acknowledged files
PG04.customer_outcome: Every selected scenario passes on one bound release: pending Start cancels/releases without saving a never-live take; request/response loss recovers exactly once; navigate-away/close-tab/takeover preserve the correct take; mic denial, model failure and offline download recover truthfully. Stop/save/reopen/next take are isolated, no hidden engine fallback or false ready/saved state. Known contradictions remainFAIL, missing evidenceHOLD. Actual phone/native-permission rows are observed separately.

PG05.name: Paid-user signup, entitlement and return journey
PG05.owner: Jensen — identity/entitlement proof; Elon — output/App-owned harness
PG05.customer_outcome: Real supported signup/sign-in and return navigation work with correct isolated identities. A genuine checkout→deployed webhook→return→paid recording path passes, with truthful trial/paid/expired states, cancellation/period-end and resumption if offered. No fake entitlement, test-mode-as-Production, skipped-required-case PASS or credential fallback. Source provisioning and observed account/payment outcomes are separately proved.

PG06.name: Correct feedback and content-safe support evidence
PG06.owner: Elon — feedback behavior; Jensen — acknowledged receipt composition; Sam — acceptance
PG06.customer_outcome: Older-take feedback links only its chosen take/coaching; no-session feedback links neither. Every submission gets its own fresh acknowledgment and correct durable/RECEIVED record. Diagnostic failures classify truthfully; exact-take/source/release identity and finite privacy observation reject unsupported audio/opaque transport without retaining content. Required shard/receipt falsifiers fail, valid execution passes; CI evidence is not live product acceptance.

PG07.name: One coherent, accessible, proven paid launch
PG07.owner: Sam — release decision/traceability; Elon — App release; named humans — device/usefulness
PG07.customer_outcome: All15 independent cases, separate genuine-paid/exit/retention/STT-quality checks and required human/device/accessibility rows pass against the same approved served/config identity. Landing/payment-disabled/enabled routes/copy are truthful; keyboard, screen reader,400%zoom and real-phone Stop/save/review controls remain usable. No mandatory FAIL/HOLD/NOTRUN is converted toPASS. Final documents/receipts match reality; obsolete wrappers retire without claiming their bugs fixed.
